title: Figure 6. MHD Control of Scramjet Inlet Using E-Beam Ionization
description: Line schematic of a scramjet forebody and inlet with incoming "Flow" arrow, "E-beams" arrows directed into the flow, a "B field" label, and a magenta arrow labeled "j×B," with oblique shock lines converging at the "Cowl lip." Captioned "Figure 6. MHD Control of Scramjet Inlet Using E-Beam Ionization. The retarding ampere force restores the shock-on-lip condition at Mach numbers higher than the design value." Text below introduces "The Ajax Concept: MHD Bypass."
